subject: Geografia

components.description_en: Identify ideas and stereotypes associated with Brazilian landscapes in media sources

components.description_pt: Avaliar a precisão de representações midiáticas sobre a formação territorial do Brasil
components.description_en: Evaluate the accuracy of media representations of Brazil's territorial formation

components.description_pt: Distinguir entre representações estereotipadas e baseadas em evidências das regiões brasileiras
components.description_en: Distinguish between stereotyped and evidence-based portrayals of Brazilian regions
components.cc_component_description: Distinguish between arguments supported by evidence and those based on opinion or unsupported assertion
